ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury Garage 2026.09.23.09 - the five-press physical factory reset never worked. Two independent bugs, both in the counter, not the reset itself. (1) The on_boot block ran at priority 800, the same as RestoringGlobalsComponent's setup_priority::HARDWARE; Application::setup() breaks that tie by registration order with a stable sort and codegen registers the trigger first, so the increment happened before the global loaded from NVS and was immediately overwritten. Moved to 700. (2) preferences flash_write_interval is 1min and a hardware RST gives no on_shutdown, so every press in a 10-second sequence landed inside the write window and was lost; the counter now flushes with update() + global_preferences->sync() on both the increment and the 10-second clear. Once the counter can reach 5, the reset itself was always correct: factory_reset calls global_preferences->reset(), which erases the NVS namespace holding the saved WiFi credentials.
